description: Defines an enumeration ChargeCalculationType representing various calculation types used for charges within the Fineract platform. Includes methods to retrieve calculation types based on integer codes, check type properties, and obtain valid values for different financial products.

classes.name: ChargeCalculationType
classes.description: An enum representing different methods of calculating charges (flat, percentage-based, etc.) with utility methods to determine type attributes.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the charge calculation type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code representing the charge calculation type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer input into the corresponding ChargeCalculationType enum, defaults to INVALID.

methods.name: isPercentageOfAmount
methods.description: Checks if the charge calculation type is percentage of amount.

methods.name: isPercentageOfAmountAndInterest
methods.description: Checks if the charge calculation type is percentage of amount and interest.

methods.name: isPercentageOfInterest
methods.description: Checks if the charge calculation type is percentage of interest.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Checks if the charge calculation type is flat.

methods.name: isAllowedSavingsChargeCalculationType
methods.description: Returns true if the type is allowed for savings charges (flat or percentage of amount).

methods.name: isAllowedClientChargeCalculationType
methods.description: Returns true if the type is allowed for client charges (only flat).

methods.name: isPercentageBased
methods.description: Checks if the type is percentage-based, including variations including interest.

methods.name: hasInterest
methods.description: Checks if the charge type involves interest calculation.

methods.name: isPercentageOfDisbursementAmount
methods.description: Checks if the charge calculation type is percentage of disbursement amount.
